KISWAHILI — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #17
====

GRADE: Grade 5
SUBJECT: KISWAHILI
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Ni sentensi ipi iliyo sahihi kisarufi? (1 mark)
   A. Kitabu anasoma mwanafunzi kwa.
   B. Anasoma mwanafunzi kitabu ya.
   C. Mwanafunzi anasoma kitabu.
   D. Mwanafunzi anasoma vitabu mzuri.

2. When practising Kusikiliza na Kuzungumza 2.1.1 Maamkuzi na Maagano, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to Kusikiliza na Kuzungumza 2.1.1 Maamkuzi na Maagano.
   B. Use insults to “practise” Kusikiliza na Kuzungumza 2.1.1 Maamkuzi na Maagano.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Kusikiliza na Kuzungumza 2.1.1 Maamkuzi na Maagano.
   D. Copy random text without understanding Kusikiliza na Kuzungumza 2.1.1 Maamkuzi na Maagano.

3. Wingi wa “mtoto” ni: (1 mark)
   A. mato
   B. kitoto
   C. mitoto
   D. watoto
